'''2010 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Matt Thornton LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Thornton]] at [[2010 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Watch Your Step Up 2: The Streets
* '''Username:''' BrenDerlin
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
